content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if these two analog outputs are electrically isolated from each other. Specifically, is it possible to connect and control devices that operate at different potentials using them?

Hello [user_name], please try to ask your questions in English. Since this is an international community, using English will allow for more responses. Here is the translation of your reply. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user sought confirmation about whether two analog outputs are isolated to safely connect devices with different electrical potentials. The response was concise but could have included more technical detail to assure users about correct application of the analog outputs in this hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect detailed guidance on the isolation properties of the hardware's analog outputs for safe and reliable operation when attaching loads at different electrical potentials.
